_comment: Input for: aws fsx create-and-attach-s3-access-point --cli-input-json file://access-point.json
Pass a file rather than positional arguments. The positional form of --ontap-configuration
parses unreliably, and the resulting error does not point at the quoting as the cause.
There is no CloudFormation resource for attaching an S3 Access Point to an FSx for ONTAP
volume, which is why this step sits outside the template instead of inside it.
Copy to access-point.json, replace the placeholders, and delete this _comment key: the API
Attach the access point to the ORIGIN volume only. This architecture serves the cache side over
NFS or SMB and puts no object access on it.
Name: s3burst-origin-ap

_FileSystemIdentity_comment: Every request through the access point is authorized as this one file system identity, so the
per-file ownership on the volume does not carry into anything reading through it. Scope access
with the access point policy and IAM, not with file permissions.
UNIX pairs with a UNIX security style volume and NFS on the fan-out side. For NTFS and SMB use
a WINDOWS identity, which requires the SVM to be joined to Active Directory — and then every
data operation through the access point needs a reachable domain controller. HeadBucket still
succeeds when the controller is unreachable, so it cannot be used to check that.

_NetworkOrigin_comment: Immutable after creation. VPC restricts the access point to a VPC; Internet makes it reachable
from outside and is NOT reachable through an S3 Gateway VPC endpoint.
For a single-host measurement, VPC with the verification host's VPC keeps the write and the
read on one clock and off the public internet. Replace the whole VpcConfiguration block with
"NetworkOrigin": "Internet" only if you need to write from outside.
